gaps.lead: 'I didn't write the graffiti,' the teenager said.
He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.lead: The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.lead: I last saw him in March.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect with since + point in time: haven't seen him since (March).

gaps.lead: It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
gaps.explanation: should/ought to have + participle expresses past regret/advice.

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.
